text:
Type: large clear glass vase
Use: holding flowers or branches on a table, a sideboard or a floor; living room, dining room, entryway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: clear glass with a thick heavy base
Colors: clear, transparent
Shape: wide tapered cylinder that flares gently toward the open rim, smooth plain sides, broad mouth, simple and roomy
Feel: light, fresh, clean, airy
Goes with: fresh flowers, green branches, light wood, white walls; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms
